pov_scope_alignment.primary_scope: Benchmark-oriented evaluation of document search over unstructured uploads.
pov_scope_alignment.secondary_scope: Agent memory retrieval APIs are included as secondary/follow-up support because the data model and query patterns explicitly include them.
out_of_scope_notes: No endpoint is defined for a structured+unstructured hybrid workflow because neither the data model nor query patterns define a concrete persisted model or retrieval pattern for that immediate use case.
No multimodal-specific extraction endpoint is defined because the authoritative model does not include image/table extraction artifacts or multimodal result structures.
No cost-estimation endpoint is defined because there is no supporting collection or query pattern for cost metrics in the authoritative artifacts.

No binary file-download endpoint is defined beyond returning document storage metadata/URI, because the model stores storage references and extracted text metadata, not a dedicated file-serving pattern.

conventions.auth: Not specified in the authoritative artifacts; tenant scoping is required in request paths/filters for all tenant-scoped resources.
